title: Offer Reason
description: Why a seller made an offer against an accepted media buy. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_offers). A routing hint; the offered commercial_terms are authoritative.

enumDescriptions.installment_postponed: A scheduled installment cannot run on its agreed date; the offer proposes a new date, a substitute, or a credit.
enumDescriptions.installment_cancelled: A scheduled installment will not run; the offer proposes a replacement, a credit, or a negotiated cancellation of that scope.
enumDescriptions.preemption: Booked inventory was preempted, typically linear. The offer proposes replacement inventory; the aired replacement is a by_spot row with replaces_spot_id.
enumDescriptions.under_delivery: The buy is forecast to miss its committed volume; the offer proposes a remedy such as an extension, a budget move, bonus units, or a makegood.
enumDescriptions.seller_request: The seller needs different terms for a reason no other value names. Use sparingly; name and description explain.
